statements:
CREATE TABLE connectors (
        connector_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        hostname TEXT,
        token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        online INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        connected_at TEXT,
        last_seen_at TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        revoked_at TEXT
      )

CREATE TABLE workers (
        worker_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        connector_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES connectors(connector_id),
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        runtime TEXT NOT NULL,
        mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'external' CHECK(mode = 'external'),
        runtime_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        capabilities_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        cwd TEXT NOT NULL,
        metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        push_capable INTEGER NOT NULL,
        work_state TEXT NOT NULL,
        current_task_id TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        retired_at TEXT, role_key TEXT, detached_at TEXT, session_cwd TEXT,
        UNIQUE(connector_id, runtime, runtime_session_id)
      )

CREATE TABLE tasks (
        task_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        title TEXT NOT NULL,
        goal TEXT NOT NULL,
        context TEXT NOT NULL,
        acceptance_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        assignee_worker_id TEXT REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      , task_number INTEGER, deleted_at TEXT, thread_key TEXT, role_key TEXT)

CREATE TABLE commands (
        command_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_id TEXT REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
        worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        sender_worker_id TEXT REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        kind TEXT NOT NULL,
        input TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        output_text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        output_truncated INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        result_json TEXT,
        error_json TEXT,
        outcome_unknown INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        accepted_at TEXT,
        started_at TEXT,
        last_activity_at TEXT,
        finished_at TEXT
      )

CREATE TABLE events (
        event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        connector_id TEXT,
        worker_id TEXT,
        task_id TEXT,
        command_id TEXT,
        payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE coordinator_config (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
        worker_id TEXT REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
        max_steps INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE coordinator_orchestrations (
        orchestration_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        parent_task_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
        coordinator_worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        status TEXT NOT NULL,
        summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        steps_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        error_json TEXT,
        auto_start INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
        source_message_id TEXT UNIQUE,
        review_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      , recovery_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, review_command_id TEXT)

CREATE TABLE coordinator_chat_messages (
        message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(role IN ('user', 'coordinator', 'activity')),
        content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('pending', 'done', 'failed')),
        request_id TEXT UNIQUE,
        command_id TEXT UNIQUE REFERENCES commands(command_id),
        task_id TEXT REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
        source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
        mentions_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
        conversation_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      , handback_reason TEXT, queued INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, batch_command_id TEXT)

CREATE TABLE watchdog_config (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
        worker_id TEXT REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        enabled INTEGER NOT NULL,
        interval_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        min_running_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        nudge_cooldown_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE attentions (
        attention_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        command_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES commands(command_id),
        task_id TEXT REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
        worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        orchestration_id TEXT,
        step_key TEXT,
        outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
        question TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open', 'answered', 'dismissed', 'approved', 'executed', 'failed')),
        answer TEXT,
        answer_command_id TEXT,
        action_json TEXT,
        execution_json TEXT,
        decided_by TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        resolved_at TEXT
      )

CREATE TABLE triggers (
        trigger_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        thread_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        source TEXT NOT NULL,
        routed TEXT NOT NULL,
        task_id TEXT,
        command_id TEXT,
        attention_id TEXT,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
      )

CREATE TABLE roles (
        role_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT NOT NULL,
        description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        takeover_after_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
      , workdir TEXT)

CREATE TABLE handoffs (
        handoff_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        task_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(task_id),
        role_key TEXT NOT NULL,
        reason TEXT NOT NULL,
        input TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        from_worker_id TEXT,
        from_command_id TEXT,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('open', 'dispatched', 'cancelled')),
        worker_id TEXT,
        command_id TEXT,
        not_before TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        resolved_at TEXT
      )

CREATE TABLE coordinator_chat_state (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
        epoch INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
      )
CREATE INDEX idx_workers_connector ON workers(connector_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_assignee ON tasks(assignee_worker_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_commands_worker ON commands(worker_id, status)
CREATE INDEX idx_commands_task ON commands(task_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_created ON events(created_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_events_command ON events(command_id, event_type)
CREATE INDEX idx_coordinator_orchestrations_status ON coordinator_orchestrations(status)
CREATE INDEX idx_coordinator_chat_created ON coordinator_chat_messages(created_at)

CREATE TABLE task_number_sequence (
        singleton INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(singleton = 1),
        next_number INTEGER NOT NULL
      )
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tasks_task_number ON tasks(task_number)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_coordinator_orchestrations_source
        ON coordinator_orchestrations(source_message_id) WHERE source_message_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_commands_sender ON commands(sender_worker_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_thread ON tasks(thread_key) WHERE thread_key IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_chat_batch ON coordinator_chat_messages(batch_command_id) WHERE batch_command_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_attentions_status ON attentions(status)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_handoffs_open_task ON handoffs(task_id) WHERE status = 'open'
CREATE INDEX idx_workers_role ON workers(role_key) WHERE role_key IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE worker_mail (
        sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        message_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
        sender_worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        recipient_worker_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workers(worker_id),
        client_message_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        in_reply_to TEXT REFERENCES worker_mail(message_id),
        command_id TEXT,
        subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
        body TEXT NOT NULL,
        accepted_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        inbox_delivered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        read_at TEXT,
        notification_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
        notification_attempted_at TEXT,
        notified_at TEXT,
        notification_error TEXT,
        UNIQUE(sender_worker_id, client_message_id)
      )
CREATE INDEX idx_mail_inbox ON worker_mail(recipient_worker_id, sequence DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_mail_outbox ON worker_mail(sender_worker_id, sequence DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_mail_pending ON worker_mail(recipient_worker_id, notification_status)
